info.title: SJKVY Platform API
info.description: Thin orchestration layer over the verified PostgreSQL function catalogue. All authorization, state transitions, idempotency and concurrency safety are enforced by the database (RLS + SECURITY DEFINER functions); the API sets the caller identity + role per transaction and invokes catalogue functions.

get.summary: Return the authenticated caller’s profile (RLS: own row only).

patch.summary: Update own profile display fields (DW: full_name, preferred_lang only).

post.summary: Confirm a verified phone change ([SYS]; provider verifies dual OTP first).
Applicant self-creates an application (and applicant record on first use).

get.summary: List applications visible to the caller (RLS: owner / operator / staff / checker).

post.summary: Operator creates an assisted application for a walk-in applicant.

patch.summary: Save draft fields on a DRAFT application (owner or assisting operator).

post.summary: Submit an application (eligibility + required-document gate, idempotent).
Applicant withdraws a pre-decision application (cascades, idempotent).
Claim an unclaimed assisted applicant record by matching phone (idempotent).
Centre admin hands a DRAFT application to another operator.

get.summary: Get a single application by id (RLS-scoped).
PUBLIC list of active centres (anon; via v_public_centres — public-safe fields only).
PUBLIC list of active courses (anon; via v_public_catalog).

post.summary: PUBLIC contact/enquiry submission (anon; via fn_contact_submit).
Record a finished upload version for an application ([SYS]).
Anti-virus/scan callback marks a version CLEAN or FLAGGED ([SYS]).
Authorize a document view and return the storage path for signed-URL minting ([SYS]).

get.summary: List document metadata for an application (path-less view, RLS-scoped).

post.summary: Centre admin assigns a checker to a pending verification case.
Centre admin reassigns the active checker (deactivates prior assignment).
Assigned checker accepts/rejects a document version (auto-verifies when complete).
Assigned checker requests document corrections (moves case to CORRECTION_REQUESTED).
Applicant resubmits after corrections (partial-aware, idempotent).
Assigned checker fails a verification case.

get.summary: List verification cases visible to the caller (owner / checker / admin).

post.summary: Counsellor schedules a counselling appointment (requires VERIFIED case).

get.summary: List counselling appointments for an application (RLS-scoped).

post.summary: Reschedule a counselling appointment (config-limited attempt count).
Mark a counselling appointment as no-show.
Record a counselling recommendation (basis for the two-step admission).

get.summary: Counselling queue for the caller (counsellor / centre admin) across applications.

post.summary: Centre admin finalizes admission (APPROVED/REJECTED/WAITLISTED, seat-safe, idempotent).
Promote the top waitlisted application when a seat is free (idempotent).

get.summary: List admission decisions for an application (RLS-scoped).
List active waitlist entries for a batch (owner or centre admin).

post.summary: Applicant accepts an admission offer → enrolment (seat-safe, idempotent).
Applicant declines an admission offer (releases the seat).
Staff confirms the student joined (ENROLLED → ACTIVE).
Centre admin marks an enrolment not-joined (releases seat, idempotent).
Transfer an enrolment to another batch (capacity-checked, idempotent).
Centre admin completes an active enrolment.
Centre admin drops an enrolment (releases bed + hostel request + seat).
Scheduled job: expire SENT offers past expiry ([SYS]).
Scheduled job: expire stale DRAFT applications ([SYS]).

get.summary: List admission offers for an application (owner or centre admin).
List enrolments visible to the caller (student self / batch staff / trainer).

post.summary: Trainer creates a class session (DW: p_sessions_ins_trainer).
Trainer marks/updates attendance for an enrolment (DW upsert on the granted columns).

get.summary: List attendance for a session (student self / trainer / centre admin).

post.summary: Trainer or centre admin locks a session’s attendance.
Centre admin corrects a locked attendance record (history row, idempotent).

get.summary: List class sessions for a batch (trainer / centre admin / student in batch).
List a batch roster (enrolments) for attendance marking.
Per-session present/absent counts for a batch (attendance report).

post.summary: Student requests hostel accommodation for their enrolment.
Student cancels a pre-allocation hostel request.
Hostel manager approves a request (APPROVED if beds free, else QUEUED).
Hostel manager allocates a specific bed (concurrency-safe, idempotent).
Transfer a resident to another bed (release+allocate in one tx, idempotent).
Discharge a resident; frees the bed and closes the request (idempotent).
Toggle a bed AVAILABLE/MAINTENANCE (not while actively allocated).
Create a hostel block (hostel_manager/centre_admin at the centre).
Create a room in a block (hostel_manager/centre_admin).
Create a bed in a room (hostel_manager/centre_admin; starts AVAILABLE).

get.summary: List hostel requests for an enrolment (student self / hostel manager).
Centre-wide hostel request queue (hostel manager / centre admin).
Bed inventory with block/room labels (hostel manager / centre admin).

post.summary: Trainer records a student result (DW: p_ares_ins_trainer; pre-finalization only).

get.summary: List results for an assessment (student self / trainer / centre admin).

post.summary: Create an assessment for a batch (centre_admin at the batch centre; migration 0004).

get.summary: List assessments for a batch (staff / trainer / enrolled student).

post.summary: Centre admin finalizes an assessment (locks results; gates certificate issue).
Centre admin issues a certificate (COMPLETED + assessment-passed gate, idempotent).
Reissue a certificate (supersede chain, idempotent).
Revoke a certificate (idempotent).

get.summary: PUBLIC certificate verification by code (uniform minimal projection).
List certificates for the caller’s centre (centre admin) or own (holder).

post.summary: Student creates a placement profile (structural consent: consent_at set).
Student withdraws placement consent (closes open referrals).
Placement staff refers a consented student to an opportunity.

patch.summary: Placement staff updates a referral status.

post.summary: Placement staff records a placement outcome (assistance record; never guaranteed).
Create an employer (placement/centre_admin staff).
Create a placement opportunity (placement/centre_admin at the centre).

get.summary: List job opportunities visible to the caller (staff / consented student).
List referrals visible to the caller (student self / placement staff).
List the caller’s in-app notifications (RLS: recipient = auth.uid()).

post.summary: Mark a notification read (DW: read_at set-once column grant).
Worker claims unprocessed domain events (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) ([SYS]).
Worker enqueues a notification for an event (dedupe on dedupe_key) ([SYS]).
Record a delivery attempt result (SENT/retry/FAILED per config) ([SYS]).
Purge expired idempotency keys ([SYS]).
Provision a staff profile + membership ([SYS]; auth user created first).

get.summary: List staff memberships at the caller’s centre(s) (centre admin) for assignment pickers.

post.summary: Grant a role membership (CAD own-centre non-admin; SAD anywhere).
Revoke a role membership (CAD own-centre non-admin; SAD anywhere).
Deactivate a staff member (offboarding; idempotent). Emits open-work event.
Create an export job (centre_admin/super_admin/placement; idempotent).
Audit an export download ([SYS]).

get.summary: Query audit events (CAD centre-scoped / SAD all).
List active centres (authenticated).
List batches (OPEN/RUNNING publicly to authenticated; all for own-centre staff).

post.summary: Create a course (super_admin only).
Add a course version (super_admin).
Create a batch (centre_admin at the centre).
Transition batch status (guarded: PLANNED→OPEN→RUNNING→COMPLETED / CANCELLED).
Create a DRAFT notice (centre_admin).
Add an audience to a DRAFT notice (centre_admin).
Publish a DRAFT notice (centre_admin).

get.summary: Verification case volume by status (centre-scoped aggregate).
Counselling appointment outcomes by status (centre-scoped aggregate).
Bed occupancy by status (centre-scoped aggregate).
Certificate issuance by status (centre-scoped aggregate).
Placement referral outcomes by status (centre-scoped aggregate).

post.summary: Request a signed upload URL for a document (user).
Finalize an uploaded document version (user; elevates to [SYS] fn).

get.summary: Authorize a document view and return a short-lived signed download URL.
